tracks.title: Architecture & Profile Freeze (aigpu-b1 & aigpu-b1-tile)
deliverables: Frozen machine-readable target architecture contract for aigpu-b1 (64-core datacenter AI-only SoC: RV64 ISA, AI-only block pruning, TFR/WGMMA tensor units, L1/L2/L3 cache hierarchy, memory-channel and host-interface topology).
Pinned aigpu-b1-tile (4-core RTL-verifiable compute tile) configuration profile with deterministic macro resolution and zero graphics/raytracing block drift.
Explicit area/memory/bandwidth budget envelope separating simulation assumptions from unacquired commercial PHY/controller/PDK dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Profile and configuration resolution pass offline checks with deterministic hash and zero VX_CFG_*_ENABLE=0 macro traps.
aigpu-b1 (64-core SoC) vs. aigpu-b1-tile (4-core tile) scaling boundaries are explicitly documented and machine-checked.

tracks.title: Compute Tile RTL & Native Datapath Verification (aigpu-b1-tile)
deliverables: Native RTL compute-tile verification for aigpu-b1-tile (4-core tile) covering RV64 SIMT cores, native TFR FP16/BF16->FP32 WMMA/WGMMA datapaths, STD scalar FPU, and local shared memory.
SimX-to-RTL cycle and retired-instruction parity regression across core, native AI operator v2, and fused inference kernels with zero DPI substitution.
Targeted RTL fault, backpressure, barrier, and warp-group metadata-ordering unit and full-processor tests.
acceptance_criteria: All declared compute-tile workloads pass native rtlsim with zero numerical mismatches against frozen references and zero DPI arithmetic substitution.
Applicable model_parity checks satisfy exact retired-instruction match and bounded cycle agreement between SimX and RTL.

tracks.title: Memory Hierarchy, Coherence & NoC Pre-Silicon Verification
deliverables: 4-core compute-tile L1/L2 coherence, atomic memory operation (AMO), DXA async copy/multicast, and memory-fabric protocol verification.
Multi-cluster / 64-core SoC NoC and memory-controller behavioral simulation model (aigpu-b1) separating RTL-verified tile behavior from simulated SoC fabric estimates.
Deadlock/livelock stress, outstanding-transaction drain, reset/recovery, and address-boundary tests in RTL simulation.
acceptance_criteria: Coherence, AMO, and DXA stress suites pass native rtlsim on aigpu-b1-tile without dropped, duplicated, or corrupted memory transactions.
AXI/memory-fabric protocol assertions and reset-drain checks report zero violations.

tracks.title: Pre-Silicon Physical Readiness, SRAM Mapping, DFT & CDC Prep
deliverables: Clean Verilator lint, Yosys/OpenSTA ASAP7 pre-layout synthesis estimates, and Beacon logic-depth/area baselines for aigpu-b1-tile.
Complete SRAM instance audit and ram_fold.py verification distinguishing real macro candidates from flip-flop arrays (explicitly non-sign-off).
Structural CDC/RDC audit, reset synchronization checklist, and scan/MBIST/JTAG RTL wrapper readiness package.
acceptance_criteria: aigpu-b1-tile RTL passes static lint and open-source synthesis/logic-depth gates without unreviewed depth/area regressions.
All predictive ASAP7/Beacon/black-box SRAM metrics remain explicitly labelled as non-sign-off pre-silicon estimates.

tracks.title: Software, Runtime, Compiler & AI Workload Stack Hardening
deliverables: Pinned RV64 toolchain/compiler-record validation and native v2 operator + Tiny-MLP/Tiny-Transformer workloads targeting aigpu-b1-tile.
Resident workspace, runtime lifetime/error-injection, and Python/PyTorch custom-op bridge regression across serialized and error boundaries.
Deterministic performance-counter and roofline baseline suite cleanly separating SimX/RTL cycle measurements from physical hardware claims.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end AI inference workloads pass native execution and host-binding negative tests on pinned aigpu-b1-tile configuration.
Compiler-record and runtime-resource accounting checks pass with zero silent CPU fallback.

tracks.title: Pre-Silicon Sign-Off Dossier & P10/P07 Handoff Package
deliverables: Consolidated pre-silicon readiness dossier linking verified evidence hashes from TRACK-A through TRACK-E with exact source commits and configurations.
Gap register explicitly enumerating all remaining physical FPGA (P01-A03, P07, P08) and commercial ASIC (ODR-007, ODR-008, P10, P11) prerequisites.
Machine-validated handoff manifest preserving roadmap.json blockers and non-waiver invariants.
acceptance_criteria: All TRACK-A through TRACK-E evidence passes offline checksum, commit, and level checks with zero fpga_measured or silicon_measured claims.
P01-A03 remains blocked and P07-P11 remain unwaived until physical hardware and human go/no-go approval are obtained.
